entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand tracker. Now. This is ridiculous.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To pull up your account, could I get your full name and order number, please?
Yeah, the name is Sam Jones. Order number 788-125B. I want a full refund, this thing is a paperweight.

Thank you, Sam. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse GPS Tracker, delivered 17 days ago on December 20th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's no issue! I just changed my mind. It was a stupid impulse buy for a New Year's resolution that's already over. I don't use it and I want my money back.

I understand. The VeloBand Pulse has some great features for building routines, like the integrated sleep tracking and performance analytics. Sometimes it can take a few workouts to see the benefits. Have you had a chance to sync it with the VeloFit coaching app?
Are you even listening?! I don't care about the features! I want to return it. Your website advertises a 90-day policy!

I can clarify that, Sam. While our apparel has a 90-day return window, our new VeloBand Pulse has a specific policy. Due to the way the device activates and for hygiene reasons, it has a strict 10-day return window for a refund. Since your device was delivered 17 days ago, it's outside that period.

TEN DAYS?! ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! That's a scam! This is completely unacceptable! I want to speak to your manager right now! I swear I will post a negative review on every single website I can find about this bait-and-switch policy!

I understand your frustration, and I am empowered to provide the final resolution on this. While I cannot process a refund, that doesn't mean you're out of options. I have a solution that many customers in your position find very helpful. Have you heard of the official VeloFit Resale Marketplace?
What the hell is that? Some scheme to sell my own stuff?

Not at all. It's our official platform that connects VeloFit users. It allows you to sell your gently used gear directly to other enthusiasts who are looking for it. Since you mentioned you don't use it, you could likely list it as 'like new' and recoup most of your money.
So... I can sell it myself and get my money back that way?

Exactly. You set the price, and because the Pulse is our newest model, there's high demand on the resale platform. They tend to sell very quickly. It's a much better option than just having it sit in a drawer. I can email you a direct link with instructions. Would that work for you?
Fine. Whatever. If I can get my money back, I guess that's better than nothing. Send me the link. Just make sure it's not complicated.
Of course. I'm sending that email to you right now. It will have a simple, step-by-step guide to creating your listing. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Sam?
No, that's it.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
